title: Capecitabine Maintenance in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (DPYD-Screened)

drugs.schedule: twice daily, days 1-14, every 21 days until progression

inclusion_criteria: Metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma with stable disease after induction
Pre-treatment DPYD genotyping completed for c.1905+1G>A, c.1679T>G, c.2846A>T and c.1236G>A per EMA 2020 guidance
exclusion_criteria: DPYD poor metabolizer phenotype; intermediate metabolizers enrol at CPIC-adjusted starting dose
